cost: F files, B bytes: validation O(F log F); install and verify O(B) hashing plus copy or download; discovery O(roots x modules) directory reads and manifest parses.
description: Add-on modules: module.json format and validation, roots and deterministic discovery, size/SHA-256 verification, staged install from a folder or an https/file URL, licence admission, removal, aria2c torrent download, and the `mova modules` command.
forward: Manifest::parse validates schema, safe names and paths, hashes, provides, layer states and requires_mova against MOVA_RELEASE 0.5; discover walks <root>/<name>/<version> sorted, first root wins; find picks the named or highest version.

Install checks admission (pinned module.json hash, --accept-nc for nc-research) and refuses Git work tree roots, stages and verifies every file, then renames into place; fetch reads file:// or curl https:// only; remove deletes only a canonical module folder.
inverse: Behavior complement: no BitTorrent transfer, no signature beyond hashes, no licence truth check, no dependency resolution, no plain HTTP, no install into a Git work tree, no loading of contents.
Reverse reconstruction: an installed folder recovers manifest and files exactly; a module.json hash recovers the manifest only by search; a failed install leaves no installed folder.
limitations: Partial source model; finite unit tests and one end-to-end run, no proof.
install-torrent exercised only without a client (no aria2c on the development box).
state: Installed modules on disk under ordered roots; no process state beyond environment-derived roots.
